text:
nora_cs: Quick pre-cutover check for Elmshore private deploy — they want to go VPC-only next Tue. Main asks: network routes/NAT, egress for audit logs (S3 + our collector), service account IAM bindings, KMS cross-account access, and audit log retention/forwarding. Renewal risk: customer expects zero-day issues; any blockers?

sanjay_infra: Network update — transit gateway peering validated. Still need confirmation on static route for 10.12.0.0/16 -> tg-attach-01. Firewall rules: allow outbound 443 to logs.redwood.com and s3.amazonaws.com, and ephemeral high ports for batching. NAT gateway provisioning is scheduled Thu morning; if that slips, log forwarding is blocked.

kevin_sre: I can own the NAT and firewall changes. ETA today EOD for prod rule rollout. Will run a canary: curl -i https://logs.redwood.com/health from customer VPC once rules applied.

elaine_security: KMS notes — I created key alias/aws/redwood/elmshore-logs (arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-elm). Need Elmshore to accept cross-account policy allowing Encrypt/Decrypt/Describe for principal arn:aws:iam::444455556666:role/redwood-logging-prod. Also we should agree rotation window (propose 30d) and enforce key policy that denies use if not through our logging role. Sample policy snippet for their review:

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodLogging",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::444455556666:role/redwood-logging-prod"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```

elaine_security: Also: audit log masking — we only forward metadata + hashed ids by default. If they need full payloads we require a signed addendum.

marta_elmshore: Thanks. Who on our side needs to click accept for the KMS policy? Also two concerns: 1) audit latency — we need <60s to S3 for compliance, 2) ensure model inputs are redacted before leaving our VPC.

nora_cs: Good qs — KMS policy needs approval from Elmshore cloud-admin (cc'd offline). Latency target noted (<60s) — kevin and sanjay, can we meet that with current NAT plan?

kevin_sre: With NAT + direct S3 endpoints + parallel uploader we should hit <60s in canary. Will validate in staging and post rule rollout.

elaine_security: For redaction: our logging pipeline strips fields named `user_input`/`prompt` and replaces with SHA256. We'll send the masking config to Elmshore for sign-off. If they ask for raw inputs, escalate to legal for addendum.

auditbot: Audit Forwarding job scheduled: 2026-03-24T02:00Z. First staging run: SUCCESS, 18s median latency to staging S3.

nora_cs: Action items: 1) @kevin_sre roll NAT+FW today and run canary, 2) @sanjay_infra confirm static routes and post route table ID, 3) @elaine_security share masking config + KMS policy draft to Elmshore cloud-admin, 4) I'll capture these in the Elmshore runbook and flag renewal as "on-watch" until green canary. Please reply when done. :thumbsup:

kevin_sre: On it — will update thread with canary result.

sanjay_infra: Route table updated: rtb-0a1b2c3d, pushed.

elaine_security: Sent policy + masking config to Elmshore cloud-admin (email thread). Waiting for acceptance.

marta_elmshore: Received — thanks all. We'll review and aim to accept by EOD.

kevin_sre: Canary from customer VPC -> logs.redwood.com: HTTP/1.1 200 OK, payload forwarded to S3 in 42s. Marking canary PASS. :white_check_mark:

nora_cs: Excellent. I'll move renewal from "on-watch" -> "green" pending KMS acceptance. Closing thread when we see the KMS policy accepted.

auditbot: KMS policy acceptance event pending.
